$comment: Standard dimension labels for yoga mats. Values are in cm for length/width, mm for thickness.

mini.label: Mini
mini.description: Small mats for targeted practice or travel

travel.label: Travel
travel.description: Compact mats for travel or kids

extra-long.label: Extra Long
extra-long.description: Maximum length for very tall practitioners

narrow.label: Narrow
narrow.description: Compact width for travel or storage

wide.label: Wide
wide.description: Extra room for broader shoulders or more space

thin.label: Thin
thin.description: Minimal cushioning, maximum stability and ground feel

extra-thick.label: Extra Thick
extra-thick.description: Maximum cushioning for sensitive joints or restorative practice

square.label: Square
square.description: Equal length and width for meditation or multi-directional practice

round.label: Round
round.description: Circular shape for meditation or 360-degree movement
